verdict.rationale: First-party docs show that WooCommerce supports product variations, user-defined attributes (e.g., a shirt in different colors), categories, and variation galleries, so it delivers variant and option modeling. Nothing in the evidence covers custom fields or metafields for extending the product schema beyond the built-in template. missing for 10: evidence of custom fields/metafields, detail on attribute/variant configuration depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.
